csv_project_name: A/E Service for Northeast Shooting Range Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Division of Wildlife operates shooting ranges at Wildlife Areas across the state. These facilities include Woodbury Shooting Range, adjacent to the Woodbury Wildlife Area in Coshocton County, and Berlin Shooting Range, adjacent to the Berlin Wildlife Area in Portage County. ODNR is soliciting professional architectural and engineering services to design and administer the renovation of Woodbury Shooting Range and the archery range at Berlin Shooting Range. Improvements at Woodbury Shooting Range will include upgrades to the rifle, pistol and shotgun ranges, improvements to the parking areas, improvements to stormwater retention facilities and the design and installation of a composting restroom facility at the range. Improvements at Berlin Shooting Range includes construction of a new parking lot and stormwater drainage system, a new covered shooting shed, new target sheds and targets, ADA-compliant walking paths, and range signage. A portion of the range is located on U.S. Army Corps of Engineers property (Buffalo District).
